minutes.headline: Cable committee approved a motion to cover a studio consultant quote and reviewed a draft FY22 budget for the Finance Committee.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee met by Zoom. The manager reported on basketball live streams, hockey coverage, and the new studio design at TC Passios. The committee went through the draft budget line by line, with corrections to revenue and interest. It voted to cover a consultant quote and set the next meeting for February 2.

budget_items.what_was_said: The manager reported the yearly music contract and the resulting fund balance, described as healthy.

budget_items.topic: Equipment maintenance and supplies; Mass Access fees
budget_items.what_was_said: Subscriptions and yearly fees are booked under equipment maintenance and supplies; Mass Access fees are due this month and he will try a purchase order.
A second vendor is expected to quote roughly in the range stated; a motion was made to cover the cost.
The manager's salary line is budgeted high in case a part-time production technician is hired.
Videographer line kept level in hope of more work after COVID.

budget_items.topic: Vendor, legal, purchase of services, consultant lines
budget_items.what_was_said: Vendor expenses unused; legal line to be removed; consultant line proposed to be lowered.
Logo clothing and office supplies lines discussed; the Ledger may offer free ad space.
Equipment line is kept high for purchases from the vendor B&H; new equipment is an emergency line that could go lower.
Health insurance budgeted in case a technician is hired; indirect costs are calculated by the town accountant.
The manager corrected the revenue estimate upward, to about a quarter-based run rate.
Interest estimate set after discussion of monthly receipts.
Unclear how to treat the retained earnings line under the new enterprise fund; to ask the town accountant.
A fourth camera aimed at the scoreboard is an option.

what_happened.line: The committee voted by show of hands to authorize spending up to a consultant's quote for studio materials and build-out review.
Members went through the draft FY22 budget line by line; Comcast revenue and interest estimates were revised during the meeting.
The legal expense line is to be removed once the manager checks with the town accountant.
Treatment of the retained earnings line under the new enterprise fund is unclear and is to be put to the town accountant.
Members will review the budget spreadsheet before it goes to the Finance Committee; the next meeting was set for Tuesday, February 2 at 5:30.

why_it_matters: The cable fund pays for local public access programming and the studio, so this budget sets how that money is used under the new enterprise fund, and it goes to the Finance Committee next.
The retained earnings question is still open, so the fund balance shown in the draft may change once the accountant answers.
